llm.summary: The skill appears to be a visa/travel guidance helper, with one privacy note around live policy lookup but no evidence of malware or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The reported capability, including destination-based visa policy lookup, fits the stated travel guidance purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The live policy update path appears to rely on an external Google search for destination-specific policy information; that is relevant to the purpose but should be user-visible.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install hook, package installer, privilege escalation, or background setup behavior was supplied or indicated by the telemetry.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Sending a destination query to Google is proportionate for live visa-policy checking, but it discloses travel-interest data to a third party.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential use, local profile/session access, or long-running worker behavior was indicated.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install if you are comfortable with a travel guidance skill that may perform live Google searches for destination policy updates. Avoid using live lookup for sensitive or private travel plans unless you accept that the destination query may be visible to Google.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The external lookup is consistent with checking current visa policy, but users should know that destination terms may be sent to Google during live updates.
[VirusTotal telemetry] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
